name: PainDraw
description: PainDraw is a REDCap external module that enables collection of **vector-based drawing data** from users directly within REDCap instruments and surveys.

authors.name: Anders Kristian Haakonsson
authors.institution: OPEN // Open Patient data Explorative Network

project-settings.name: Configure PainDraw drawing canvas (one per image)

sub_settings.name:
Select an instrument for the PainDraw drawing canvas.
NOTE: You can only have one PainDraw drawing canvas pr. REDCap instrument.

Specify a file-upload field to host the PainDraw canvas.
NOTE: The field must be on the selected instrument

Upload image file for the drawing canvas.
NOTE: Something about supported file formats

If you want a copy of the generated image stored in an file upload field on the instrument, specify which field here.
NOTE: The field must be on the same instrument as the PainDraw drawing canvas.
MD5 sum of image, ensures consistency

Specify width of drawing canvas in pixels
NOTE: Will be set automatic based on image dimensions if left blank

Specify height of drawing canvas in pixels
NOTE: Will be set automatic based on image dimensions if left blank

Line or spray point color (default red: '#fc3d03')
NOTE: Must be HEX format
Transparency of drawn lines or spray points [0 - 100] % (default: 0% for pen, 90% for spray)
Spray density. Apply this many pixels to drawing pr. coordinate (default 15)
